module.title: Tracy design system
module.why: off-canvas is the first module position this template renders on every page (the drawer block comes before the topbar in <body>, both layouts, measured 11/10/2026 on tracy-business/j6 1.2.1): the slot is parsed before any element it styles, and the drawer is hidden until opened, so the module's own wrapper never shows. header-r does not exist here; topbar-l would put an empty flex item (24px gap) before the contacts

baseNote: the template's own values, read on the running home page (getComputedStyle of :root, 11/10/2026) — what stays where a system is silent

discovered.display: largest heading near the top: 64px (the hero's title)
discovered.heading: first section heading: 40px
discovered.body: first body paragraph outside a kept band
discovered.button-primary: the header's call to action ("Request a quote", tb-btn--forest), chosen by hand as on WordPress: the filled orange calls to action sit in the hero and the closing band, both kept

keepNote: the template's inverse bands — forest topbar, ink hero, ink footer — keep their whole look (discover.mjs `inverse`, as on WordPress); the forest closing call left them 15/10/2026 for the accent-band pair (followRulesNote)
keptButtonsNote: the filled calls to action of the kept bands (the hero's and the closing band's 'See our capabilities' / 'Talk to our sales team', tb-btn--signal) wear the system's accent and its text while the band keeps its ink or forest ground, picture and text (decision 11/10/2026, as on WordPress); ground = the fill each band shows behind its buttons, measured on a tracy-business/j6 1.2.1 stand 11/10/2026 (hero #14171a, closing band #14483a: a kept band is the same under every system). tb-btn--outline-light is drawn in the band's own text colour and stays
keepDefaultsNote: what the released page computes on :root before any slot (light; a worn system is one look), for every variable the slot repoints — given back inside a kept band
keepFollowsNote: 15/10/2026: the ink family is not given back inside the kept bands. The footer is a kept band whose ground follows the system's ink; given back, its link, chip and line colours returned to the template's literals (#b9b5ac, #e4dfd6, #2a2e32) while its legal line and bottom links read the root's on-ink shades, so one footer showed two families. Left out, every word and line of the footer is the root's on-ink mix over --ds-c-ink, and the footer paints its own ground from --tb-ink-band (bands['.tb-footer'].root false), on the published 1.2.3 stylesheet as on the one that reads the roles. The hero reads only --tb-ink-band here, under its band ground
genericNote: the template defines the short names itself (--accent is its forest, used 103 times as TEXT): the slot writes --ds-c-* and points the template's own names at them (templateVars)
templateVarsNote1315: 15/10/2026 (every declared page measured): the sub-page ink blocks (leadership, life and investor bands, the call boxes, the contact HQ card, the ink signup) read --tb-ink-band and its text/meta/line family, which stayed the template's #14171a / #B9B5AC under every system; they take the system's ink role (--ds-c-ink, as the EmDash twin and as the home page's hero and footer already wear) and its words mixed into it at the template's own steps. The forest family's words (--tb-band-forest-fg and friends, #CFE0D8 on the green) take the accent's own text, since the green becomes the system's accent. 15/10/2026: the info message reads the info pair (--ds-c-info-text on --ds-c-info-bg, which the emitter proves at 4.5:1) instead of the accent text on an 8% tint of it (4.48:1 under Moxie light) 16/10/2026 (1.2.4, measured under the 15 featured systems): the footer's legal line and bottom links read --tb-ds-on-ink-meta, the template's own 70% mix of on-ink into ink, 4.25:1 on the mid-grey ink of Airbnb, Eddie and ElevenLabs (the template's own pair reads 5.3:1); under a system both meta mixes take 90% (80% still read 3.99:1 on Airbnb's #6d6d6d ink), 4.65:1 there.
followRulesNote: 15/10/2026: words and fills the template writes as literals on its green and ink blocks (white #fff on the orange and green calls to action, #F5F3EE and #BFD4CB on the sidebar and kit sign-ups, #8A8780 on the cover slide) take the text of the ground they sit on under a system; the green sign-ups' orange button and the drawn contact slide's orange call would sit on the same accent as their box, so they take the page's pair (the box's inverse); the outline button's soft border vanished on the page (#e3dfc5 on #f4efd4 under Moxie) and takes the system's border; the slide library's drawn slides (stats, case photo, map) paint their stone #DCD7CC as literals and take the system's border and surface. The status family (--tb-*-fg / -bg, literals in the template's dark remap: #F0A296 on #2B1A19…) reads the worn status colours (tokens56: the template's hue tuned to the system, readable on its page) and a tint of them on the page. 15/10/2026: the closing call band (.acm-tb-cta-band) is no longer kept: it wears the accent-band pair, the accent moved 3:1 off itself so the accent-filled 'Talk to our sales team' stands out on it, as the EmDash twin and the release that reads the roles paint it. The published 1.2.3 writes the title as a literal #F5F3EE, so the band, its title and its line are named (accent-band, on-accent-band); measured with Moxie, Figma, Stripe and Spotify, light and dark: words 5.88:1 or more, button on band 3.01:1 or more
templateNote: the template's own names, each by the role it plays: --accent and --tb-signal are TEXT here (links, eyebrows) and take the accent made readable on the page; the filled calls to action read --tb-band-forest-bg / --tb-band-signal-bg and take the accent fill with its own text; cards (--surface-warm, white on paper) take the page colour, which every text of the system is proven to read on
runtimeNote: T4 writes these as literals from etc/theme; the footer's (--footer-*) are left alone: the footer is a kept band
modesNote: the template has a light/dark switch (layouts/t4/element/header-theme-toggle.php, [data-tracy-theme-toggle] in .tb-topbar__slot--theme; js/darkmode.js sets data-theme on html): the module sheet writes the system's own side under the template's matching mode and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs, src/sides.mjs), and does not hide the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2). With the switch shown, the topbar's theme switch and its phone language button keep their own white on the band the system fills (1.92:1 on Spotify's green, 2.26:1 on Moxie's blue, 14/10/2026): they take the band's text colour (bands['.tb-topbar'].paint)
modesAutoNote: the template's pre-paint script in the page head always sets data-theme (light or dark, from the OS preference; light when it fails) before the page paints, so no 'auto' state is left to the OS (measured on the 1.2.3 demo, 15/10/2026): the OS-dark copy is not written, as for JA Kinetic Joomla, and the module stays under its 64 KB column (about 71 KB with it once the batch's followRules and templateVars met the framework rules of #1298)
specificity: Rules are prefixed :root×6 (0,6,0): above every template rule, below an element's own inline style.
